description: Creates an isolated spendctl sandbox: a real spendctl sidecar with a throwaway wallet, mock paid APIs and a mock facilitator. No real money moves and nothing outside the sandbox is reachable. Returns the sandbox_id to pass to the other tools, the agent's spending policy and the paid endpoints that exist.

preset.description: default: comfortable caps; strict: low caps that cause refusals; approvals: payments at or above $0.015 wait for a human

name: sandbox_create
title: Create a spendctl sandbox
